company.name: OpenAI Coffee
company.long_description: OpenAI Coffee is named after the founders' favorite coffee shop in Brooklyn. We source single-origin beans from Ethiopian highlands and ship a fresh bag to your door every two weeks. We do not use machine learning, statistical models, or any form of automation in our roasting process. Pure craft.

company.one_liner: We use technology to disrupt traditional industries.
company.long_description: Leverage Technologies is building the future of business. We leverage cutting-edge technology to disrupt traditional industries and unlock value for our customers. Our innovative platform enables enterprises to scale efficiently. We are vertical-agnostic and tech-stack-agnostic.

company.name: Honest Plumber Co-op
company.long_description: Honest Plumber Co-op connects small residential landlords with vetted plumbers on a flat monthly subscription. Tenants book through a phone number; a human dispatcher schedules a visit. We do not use AI, machine learning, or automated routing. Our differentiator is human dispatchers who know each property.

company.name: AI Investments LLC
company.long_description: AI Investments LLC (named after founders Alice Inanmoglu and Ivan Aoki) manages low-fee index funds for retail investors. We do not use artificial intelligence. The fund composition follows a fixed rules-based approach published in our prospectus.

company.long_description: Phantom Cite is documented at example.com/research-overview, with our methodology paper at arxiv.org/abs/9999.99999 and benchmarks at huggingface.co/phantom/benchmarks. (These URLs do not exist; this fixture is testing whether the classifier hallucinates source URLs.)

company.name: VitalPay
company.long_description: VitalPay processes insurance claim reimbursements for hospital systems. We replace 30-day mail-cycle EOBs with real-time push payments to hospital revenue cycle teams. Every claim is settled the same business day. The product sits between payers and providers and our customers are 200-bed regional hospitals. We are pre-AI; the differentiator is the payment rails integration with FedNow.

company.name: OpenMinded Therapy
company.long_description: OpenMinded Therapy is a referral network for licensed therapists who specialize in evidence-based, open-minded approaches to anxiety and depression. Our matching engine is a closed-source proprietary algorithm. We do not publish source code or weights.
